exposure: Detection of SSI before hospital discharge
outcome: Post-operative duration before developing surgical site infection (SSI)
Late-onset surgical site infection (>= median duration)
cohort: The study included 322 surgical site infection events following 15 different operative procedures performed between 2014 and 2023 in a tertiary-care hospital system.
finding: Early-onset surgical site infection was significantly associated with female gender and detection before hospital discharge, but inversely associated with coronary artery bypass graft procedures.
followup_time: Up to 60 days post-operation for SSI detection (with discussion of 90 days)
